title: eludite/templates/create
description: Create a project from a `dotnet new` template (brief 0072; host-rpc.md, "Templates and items"): optionally `dotnet new sln` first (`newSolution`), then `dotnet new <shortName> --name <name> --output <output>` with the language and parameters, then `dotnet sln <solution> add <project>` when a solution is given or created. Each step runs out of process with telemetry and the first-run banner off; a failing step stops the rest. Needs no open solution.

language.description: `--language` (`C#`, `F#`, `VB`) for a template offered in several.

output.description: `--output`: the absolute folder the project is created in.

solution.description: An existing `.sln` or `.slnx` to add the new project to.

newSolution.description: An `.slnx` to create first (`dotnet new sln --name <its name> --output <its folder>`), then add the project to.

exitCode.description: 0 when every step succeeded, else the failing step's exit code.

files.description: The files under `output` that did not exist before, absolute, sorted.

project.description: The created project file, when there is one.

primaryFile.description: The file to open: the template's first non-project primary output (`Program.cs`, `Class1.cs`), else the project file.

solution.description: The solution the project was added to.

output.description: The steps' standard output and error, in order.

commandLines.description: The command lines run, in order.
